safetyReview.notes: DRAFT household routine template (redesign EXEC-R1), authored 2026-10-23 by Claude (agent). The If/Then wording is the owner-approved example text from EXEC-R1; every source is a page already cited by reviewed or pilot content in this repo for the same hazard. Review tier LIFE_SAFETY: needs the independent safety review at the exact hash before it can be PUBLISHED; the author does not approve it. Only visible under the local preview gate until then. Revised 2026-10-23 for Gate 1 + Gate 2 (REVISION_REQUIRED at sha256:e6f33253…): restates the absolute rule (NWS: never drive or walk into flood waters) and makes the saved route conditional on being open and dry, with a wait-high alternative, so a stored route never reads as automatically safe; fallback names an unflooded road instead of an empty 'our backup route'.

content.title: Water on the road
content.summary: Keep a short flooded-road routine on your household plan: turn around, and the backup route your household takes instead.

routine.title: Water on the road
routine.thenTemplate: We turn around and never drive or walk into water. We take {route} only if it's open and dry, or wait somewhere high.
